method: For each climate, aggregate 12 seeds (1–12), 1,000,000 simulation ticks per seed at 40 ticks/s (1x). Durations are measured in real seconds; wet fraction includes rain and storm.
climateBehavior: All four climates produced the same weather cadence before and after; climate continues to affect monthly base temperature only.
cycle: 36 in-game days ≈ 475 seconds (7m55s) at 1x; dawn and dusk each ≈39.6 seconds.
determinism: State transition still invokes the seeded RNG once for the next kind and once for the duration. Weather state and save schema are unchanged.
